caveats: The equity series are repository-owned CNN-inspired composites, not CNN historical indices.
BTC-USD is an explicit assumed crypto target for a market-wide CMC signal and may be the wrong benchmark.
^OMXSBGI and ^STOXX are indices and are not directly investable.
Inputs are current-history downloads, not point-in-time vintages; historical revisions and survivorship effects cannot be excluded.
The equity model may carry an individual component score for up to seven calendar days across source-market holidays.
Yahoo chart data are convenient research inputs, not an exchange-grade execution feed.
Costs omit spreads, slippage, taxes, funding/cash yield, borrow/custody, and venue constraints.
Multiple descriptive band and strategy views are secondary; only the declared 20 slope tests receive BH adjustment.

frozenDesign.completeBarPolicy: The retrieval-local calendar date is excluded for every target to avoid still-forming daily bars.
frozenDesign.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg over exactly 20 holdout slope tests
frozenDesign.forwardReturn: simple close-to-close return from t+1 entry close to t+1+h exit close
frozenDesign.incremental: Expanding 21-observation blocks; controls are lagged 1/5/20-bar returns, annualized 20-bar realized volatility, and close/125-bar SMA trend; all scaling fitted on available training only
frozenDesign.missingSignals: Never backfilled; fixed-rule strategy is in cash for a period lacking a strict signal
frozenDesign.neweyWest: OLS score scaled per 10 points; Bartlett HAC bandwidth max(horizon, floor(4*(N/100)^(2/9))), capped N-3; two-sided asymptotic normal p-value
frozenDesign.primaryHypothesis: Higher greed predicts lower future return; statistical p-values are two-sided
frozenDesign.splitOverlapPurge: Training observations must have exitIndex <= first holdout entryIndex; the original 60% boundary still defines the holdout and incremental forecast slice.
frozenDesign.strategyCost: 10 basis points per absolute 0/1 position change, including initial entry; zero cash return
